dependencies.name: Orientation-Closure Bridge
dependencies.root_statement: Orientation coherence conditions admissible knot-class selection under selector-form routing; closure stability remains residue-conditioned.
dependencies.formal_dependency: knot_class_selection = f(orientation_coherence, residue_support, admissibility); closure_survival = f(residue_support, admissibility, topology_class)

axiom_level.reason: The primary axiom does not depend on OPEN_BRIDGE_001.

dependencies.required_primitive_input_note: orientation_space_O is no longer an open primitive input. O is defined as a derived container per textbook §5.1.2 and §5.1.4. The actual unresolved measurable requirements for OPEN_BRIDGE_001 proof obligations PO_001-PO_003 are C_orient (orientation coherence metric, must not presuppose closure topology) and T_class_metric (topological class variance measure). [Audit: MPF_ORIENTATION_STALENESS_AUDIT_001 P6]

governance_rules.rule: Any claim downstream of an unresolved bridge may not be promoted above the bridge's current claim level.
governance_rules.effect: If OPEN_BRIDGE_001 is C1_defined_provisional, dependent claims cannot exceed that ceiling except as explicitly marked speculative projections.

governance_rules.rule: If OPEN_BRIDGE_001 is falsified, all dependent claims must enter REVIEW_LOCK until rewritten, rerouted, or retired.
If OPEN_BRIDGE_001 survives falsification, support propagates only to immediate structural claims unless separately tested.
